summary: All 19 sounds of thrusters (4), impacts (8) and landing (7) are rendered into assets/audio/render and in the manifest (the brief says 17; sounds.json holds 19). Every rule other than the CLAP margin passes for all 19. CLAP margin is positive for 8 and slightly to clearly negative for 11; design was kept (see doubts). Library tests green (15).
built: tools/audio/synth/cat_impacts.py: hull hits, shield hits, hull groan, debris, plus the shared helpers ring_events, no_dc, blow, creak, hum
tools/audio/synth/cat_thrusters.py: three thruster pulses, thruster burn loop
tools/audio/synth/cat_landing.py: gear deploy/retract, touchdown soft/hard, settle creak, ground scrape loop, dust patter loop (helpers whine, flatten, _wrapped_times)

sounds.recipe: Valve knock (700 Hz low-passed noise tick) then a 95->52 Hz thump with 4.5 ms rise through the hull, hull ring short.
sounds.seen: Dull knock, energy 30-300 Hz decaying in about 80 ms; peak -12.0, CLAP -0.018.
sounds.doubt: CLAP margin -0.018 against 'a gunshot'; a very short dull thump is close to that for the model.

sounds.recipe: Same event, 82->46 Hz, slightly longer, 5 ms rise, softer tick.
sounds.seen: Same shape as A, a little lower; CLAP -0.009.

sounds.recipe: Stronger: 112->58 Hz, longer ring, a few weak rattles.
sounds.seen: Longer ring than A, still nothing above 700 Hz except the faint rattles; CLAP -0.053.

sounds.recipe: Brown noise through the hull, 58 Hz four-partial beating pump with a 29 Hz roughness, pink hiss 140-1000 Hz weakly present; all through the 650 Hz low-pass; periodic.
sounds.seen: Steady band below 100 Hz with visible beating lines, a weak hiss floor to 900 Hz; seam ratio 0.3, swing 5.1 dB; CLAP -0.030.
sounds.doubt: CLAP margin -0.030 against 'white noise hiss'; the hiss is deliberately weak so the structure rules hold (lowShare 0.99).

sounds.recipe: One blow (88->48 Hz thump, 2.5 ms burst through hull, modes struck at 0.15) shared with medium and heavy.
sounds.seen: Short thunk, low modes ring briefly, no rattles; CLAP +0.041.

sounds.recipe: Same blow, stronger: 100->50 Hz, ring 1.5, modes 0.35, some rattles.
sounds.seen: Modes visible 37-300 Hz for about a second, faint 1-3 kHz rattles; CLAP +0.099.

sounds.recipe: Same blow at full strength (112->44 Hz, 0.4 s thump, modes 0.8 with seeded phases) plus a stick-slip groan 52-79 Hz from 1.5 s.
sounds.seen: Low modes at 37-90 Hz carry to about 1.5 s, then the groan swells 1.6-2.3 s; CLAP +0.012.
sounds.doubt: CLAP margin only +0.012 (music is the closest competitor).

sounds.recipe: Gliding odd-harmonic 100 Hz hum with growl AM and a coarse noise buzz following the load, short hull, soft thump.
sounds.seen: Hum line near 100 Hz with harmonics to 700 Hz, no ringing modes; CLAP -0.160.
sounds.doubt: CLAP margin -0.160 against 'a cheap electronic beep': a tonal hum reads as a beep to the model. A second attempt with more buzz and growl did not help.

sounds.recipe: Same, load 0.75, pitch sag 12 %, recovery 0.3 s.
sounds.seen: Louder growl band, sag visible; CLAP -0.094.

sounds.recipe: Same, load 1.0, pitch sag 34 % at 0.1 s, recovery 0.65 s, sustained level.
sounds.seen: Peak tracked in the file: 68 Hz at 0.05 s, 78 at 0.3, 91 at 0.9, 96 at 1.5 s, so it drops and climbs back slowly; CLAP -0.078.

sounds.recipe: Two long stick-slip groans (47-64 Hz and 83-118 Hz) and four shorter creaks of 120-300 Hz, small knock at 0.4 ms for the onset, through the hull.
sounds.seen: Slow swell peaking near 1.1 s with creak streaks at 0.5, 1.7, 2.7 and 3.1 s; CLAP +0.057.
sounds.doubt: Only a listener can say whether the stick-slip reads as metal or as a buzzing note.

sounds.recipe: 150 tiny blows (160-560 Hz decaying ticks) with a decaying rate and uneven gaps, a dozen larger dull thumps, weak rattles.
sounds.seen: Dense start thinning to isolated events by 2.2 s, a few bigger thumps at 0.5 and 1.55 s; CLAP -0.108.
sounds.doubt: CLAP margin -0.108 (second attempt with sharper higher ticks was worse); the pattering is low because the structure rules cap everything near 500 Hz.

sounds.recipe: Soft uplock knock, pump whine rising 150->255 Hz with two harmonics and fluid gush for 1.5 s, hard lock clunk at 1.66 s, small re-seat at 1.86 s.
sounds.seen: Rising line with harmonics to 700 Hz, then a broad thump with ringing modes; CLAP +0.016.
sounds.doubt: Whine level versus clunk is a guess (0.22 factor).

sounds.recipe: Strong clack at the start, whine falling 235->150 Hz, softer door thud at 1.6 s.
Two soft blows 180 ms apart (72->42 and 64->40 Hz), short creak 95-130 Hz.
sounds.seen: Two separate thumps then a faint creak; CLAP +0.084.

sounds.recipe: Heavy blow (118->42 Hz, modes 0.8, rattles) with a second leg strike 70 ms later, creak at 1.35 s.
sounds.seen: Strong onset, low modes ringing to 1.4 s, creak 1.4-2.1 s; CLAP +0.161.

sounds.recipe: Pink noise 35-520 Hz through the hull, levelled with a circular local-RMS division, gated by irregular grit (1.5-45 Hz noise squared), finer grit 150-900 Hz, 26 stone catches at uneven times (density from periodic random wander), weak rattles.
sounds.seen: Gritty low band with stones as vertical streaks at uneven spacing, no repeating pattern; swing about 4 dB, seam ratio 0.11, edge diff 1.0 dB; CLAP -0.037.
sounds.doubt: CLAP margin -0.037 against the arcade description. The levelling makes it quite even, so it may sound steadier than 'stones catching'.

sounds.recipe: 1500 small ringing ticks (150-440 Hz, 8-28 ms) at times drawn from a wandering periodic density, plus 18 duller pebbles, low-passed; periodic.
sounds.seen: Even broad granular texture 50-700 Hz, seam ratio 0.53, swing 6.0 dB (limit 6); CLAP -0.091.
sounds.doubt: CLAP margin -0.091; swing sits at the limit. Fewer, more contrasty grains sounded closer to the intent but broke the swing and seam rules.

sounds.recipe: Seven metal ticks at uneven times on upper hull modes plus one creak 70-105 Hz at 0.5 s.
sounds.seen: Isolated tick columns at 100-300 Hz, creak band 0.55-1.2 s; CLAP -0.131.
sounds.doubt: CLAP margin -0.131 against 'music'; tonal ticks at 100-300 Hz read as notes to the model. Very quiet by design (-18 dBFS peak).

deviations: The brief says 17 sounds; sounds.json holds 19 in these three categories (thrusters 4, impacts 8, landing 7)
Three category files as asked, but cat_thrusters and cat_landing import shared helpers from cat_impacts (blow, creak, no_dc, ring_events); they could move into the library

LEVELS is extended at import time from my cat files (LEVELS.update) instead of editing levels.py: thruster_burn_loop -30 LUFS, hull_stress_groan -8, debris_patter -9, gear_deploy -8, gear_retract -9, settle_creak -18 dBFS peak, ground_scrape_loop -28 LUFS, dust_patter_loop -34 LUFS. These entries should move into levels.py

CLAP margin is negative for 11 sounds (thruster pulses A-C, burn loop, shield hits x3, debris, scrape, dust, settle creak); kept per the brief after more than three attempts on some, recorded in doubt
A 6 Hz first-order high-pass (no_dc) is applied to every blow so the one-shot offset stays under 0.001
openIssues: Shield hits sound like a hum with growl; if the owner hears a beep, the hum needs more noise and less harmonic order
The two landing loops are evened out to pass the swing rule; the owner may want more unevenness (raise swing_max with register(id, swing_max=...) in cat_landing.py)
settle_creak and debris_patter are very low in pitch because of the structure rules
forNextAgent: Files: tools/audio/synth/cat_impacts.py, cat_thrusters.py, cat_landing.py. Build one: .venv-audio/Scripts/python.exe tools/audio/build.py --only <id> [--no-clap]; picture at assets/audio/render/<category>/<id>.png. Per-sound parameters are the dicts THRUSTERS, HULL, SHIELD in the cat files; blow() in cat_impacts is the shared blow. Loops use ring_events(periodic=True) and _wrapped_times so events wrap around the loop end; flatten() levels slow swells (needed for the scrape). Pitfalls: a blow leaves DC (use no_dc); ring events with equal phase make a peak spike (use seeded phases); one-shots need a loud event within 5 ms (the groan and settle creak start with a small knock for that); the 100 ms swing rule fails easily on sparse events.
